seeds.release: separate review after development evidence; no holdout tuning

hash.h: M(seed xor M(i xor 0x9e3779b97f4a7c15) xor rotl64(M(j xor 0xd1b54a32d192ed03),32) xor tag)

reference.field: r1 Hc from actual wired raw continents bilinear + unchanged GradientNoise
reference.anchor_height: h=floor(Hc(center))+0.5, only if interval has one unambiguous floor bin
reference.seed_semantics: same raw seed; original r1 Hc role seed; no seed+phaseIndex
reference.reference_model: stored binary64 integer continents outputs define exact bilinear model; outward error separate

nodes.coverage_rule: core vs collar vs actual influenced area separate; support disk is upper bound, not safe area
nodes.finite_roi_support_budget_domain: union of both frozen ROI squares; per-window area also reported, not asserted identical

ports.terminal_certificate: continuous interval/derivative bound or equivalent verified physical increment envelope; never sparse samples only
ports.endpoint_height: floor(lo_p)+.5 only if floor(lo_p)==floor(hi_p), proven Hp error <=2^-24; unknown rejects

physical_certificate.increment: abs(hhat(p)-hhat(q)) <= L_model*d + 2*E; only d>=0.25 within certified corridor domain
physical_certificate.below_scale: continuous model enclosure plus point error only; no homogeneous rounded Lipschitz claim

valley_graph.edge_rule: r1 x/all, z/hash probability .35 using canonical IDs; node positions use r2 tags
valley_graph.eligibility: ANCHOR_DRY only, never port results: no circular dependence on Smooth terrain

preparation.shortlist: per-window dry anchors whose support disk fits ROI, sorted exact-dyadic squared distance to frozen window center then global ID; union; no refill after port rejection
preparation.timing_status: NOT_MEASURED; counts are bounds, time/retained bytes need actual Java preflight
preparation.scheduling: owner server thread; slice raw calls AND geometry/certification work; no background Level use
preparation.scope_of_budget: each arm per seed/ROI union; FULL verification separate, cannot be hidden here
preparation.overrun: BLOCK_ENTIRE_PROFILE, preserve first failure, no partial publication or parameter changes

arm_A.node_distribution: same r2 candidate IDs for fair A/B comparison
arm_A.model: retain raw Hc; certify local footprint physical increment <=1/8 with error; FULL actual dual-phase landing mandatory
arm_A.yield: UNKNOWN; no promise localizing the proof cures ocean/real cliffs

arm_B.terrain_edit: future dev-only profile, NOT implemented in B2
arm_B.height_model: flat core + quintic controlled ramps + certified terminal handoff, Protocol sections 3-5

future_gates.endpoint_graph: components and isolated nodes reported; endpoints/anchor-valley graph are not walking edges
future_gates.full_target_selection: first 2 MATH_NODE_READY nodes/window by frozen ranking; union; no replacements after failure
future_gates.port_validation: at least same opposite pair in both phases, actual support/collision/fluid/hazard; changes require revalidation
future_gates.shift: real native player, both directions, unchanged x/z, y within +/-4; no DEV_SURFACE
future_gates.route: at least one completed useful source-obstacle/alternate-phase/exit route per development seed, survival walk/jump; NO teleport across gap
future_gates.visual: phase feature tests remain independent; environment/flat nodes not morphology PASS
future_gates.world_generation: requires separate approval after r2 native preflight; no authorization token or runtime entrypoint in B2
future_gates.full_scan_chunk_scope: explicit FULL requests for chosen opposite ports, body footprint and core only; incidental native neighbour generation separately tracked, cannot be assumed zero
future_gates.full_port_pair_selection: first common opposite pair in E/W then N/S order from math results; no fallback after FULL failure
future_gates.full_annular_isolation: any observed terrain-ring isolation blocks whole profile; no post-generation DF eligibility change

future_worlds.rules: CREATE_NEW_OR_FAIL, approved digest + source/settings fingerprint; mismatch blocks, no old save upgrade
controls: r1 negative preflight only, no blocked r1 worlds
future_worlds.camera: same legacy seed/window/camera/noon/clear/neutral sky; no B2 captures

states_semantics: DF activation is immutable MATH_NODE_READY only after full numerical preflight; later FULL/dynamic state never changes density or rerolls terrain
